ARBITER.Settings.BackendUrl.Name: Backend URL
ARBITER.Settings.BackendUrl.Hint: Address of the VTT Automaton backend, e.g. https://arbiter.example.com
ARBITER.Settings.Token.Name: Client token (GM only)
ARBITER.Settings.Token.Hint: Stored only in this browser. Only the GM's browser connects to the backend; players can leave this empty.
ARBITER.Settings.SpeakerName.Name: Speaker name
ARBITER.Settings.SpeakerName.Hint: Name shown on ruling chat cards.
ARBITER.Settings.VoiceRulings.Name: Answer spoken questions
ARBITER.Settings.VoiceRulings.Hint: Post rulings for questions asked out loud ("Nethys, …") and picked up by the session transcription.
ARBITER.Error.NoMatch: No matching rules were found. Try the English name of the action, condition or spell.
ARBITER.Error.Timeout: The backend did not answer in time.
ARBITER.Error.NoGm: No GM is connected, so the arbiter cannot answer right now.
ARBITER.Error.NotConnected: The arbiter is not connected to the backend.
ARBITER.Error.EmptyQuery: Write a question after the command, e.g. /rule what does Trip do?
ARBITER.Status.Disconnected: Arbiter lost the backend connection; reconnecting…
ARBITER.Status.AuthFailed: Arbiter: the backend rejected the client token. Check the module settings.
ARBITER.Status.NotConfigured: Arbiter: set the backend URL and client token in the module settings.
